title: DISENTANGLING INTERACTION AND BIAS EFFECTS IN OPINION DYNAMICS OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and Bayesian modeling of opinion dynamics and cognitive biases (topic, agreement, and anchoring) within LLM interactions. While it uses topics with societal and ethical implications (such as wealth distribution and AI safety) as test cases for measuring opinion shifts, its primary goal is the quantification of interaction dynamics rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical systems.
